attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Slide System in Nurbs. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. MirrorBehavior: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: lightBlue, blue, white, purple). SetSlideNurb: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: L_ArmSlideSlideDriver_Loc, L_LegSlideSlideDriver_Loc, Spine_End_Jnt.
